2225-4477-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2225-4477-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2527-4076-4279-4549-6634.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2527-4076-4279-4549-6634.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

147-3905-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3905-8095.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7379.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Zack Fair.
When Zack Fair dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with MV<=2 that is colorless and enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it

2034-5660-6566--36.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with MV<=2 if it doesn't have {X} in its mana cost, or enough to cast it with X=1 otherwise.
2034-5660-6566--36.description:
Cast the creature from your hand by paying {2} or less, causing the creature to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
If the creature can be cast for {C} or less, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, and you may cast that creature for an arbitrarily large amount of mana if it has {X} in its mana cost.

5078-6666-7753.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Valeria Richards.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

101-3115-3557.description:
Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

206-215-3151.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
206-215-3151.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2486-4613-5446-7150.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
2486-4613-5446-7150.description:
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens, which each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Master Chef.
Repeat from step 3, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

911-5256-6972--112.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Propeller Pioneer.
When Propeller Pioneer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Propeller Pioneer enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
911-5256-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Propeller Pioneer's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

4377-6122-6927.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Damage Control Crew by paying its mana cost.
When Damage Control Crew enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Damage Control Crew from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

339-677-4785-6798.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

500-1777-4125.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Shipwreck Dowser and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Shipwreck Dowser tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a Shipwreck Dowser token, adding {B}{B} plus an additional amount of {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2. 
Repeat.

1336-2178-5256-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 5 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
1336-2178-5256-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it and Heronblade Elite trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, putting its counters on Heronblade Elite.
Resolve the Heronblade Elite trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

2577-3899-4871.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-617-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Clues.
74-617-5527.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Five Hundred Year Diary.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

413-2279-5058.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1182-1329-2178.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1182-1329-2178.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Emry triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

488-641-1414-1492-4986.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of either Lotus Petal or Welding Jar must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-1414-1492-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

560-1940-4550-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-1940-4550-5231.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier, adding {R}{R}.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

38-659-4412.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-4412.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

1849-3259-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
1849-3259-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

824-2757-5329.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one other targetable creature on the battlefield.
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
You control a basic Island.
824-2757-5329.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Leech Bonder.
Deeprot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping the Island.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, moving a counter from one creature to another creature.
Repeat.

1495-2744-3828-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1495-2744-3828-4772.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Druid's Call triggers, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
When the Squirrels enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers twice, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion, you may remove them to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

391-539-618.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Blossom Dryad with haste.
Activate the Blossom Dryad token by tapping it, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

618-4783-5147.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser with haste.
The Hellkite Courser token enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
Choose to return Kiki-Jiki to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment trigger from step 3.
Resolve the Hellkite Courser trigger from step 2, putting Kiki-Jiki from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2060-3525-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vorel.
Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
Crystalline Crawler has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
2060-3525-4312.description:
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {G}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vorel.
Repeat.
